# PR #2155: Patch: a deck holding a card the newest patch changed says so, and what changed

Closes #2097

## What changed and why

A saved deck in the workshop whose latest save predates the newest shipped patch, and which holds cards that patch changed, now wears a "N cards changed in vX" badge on its list row and in its open editor. Pressing the badge opens exactly those held cards, each with its `ChangeList` as the patch history words it. Flavor-only changes never count (R1437000), nor Glitch, added, or removed cards; data-only changes do count. Saving the deck under the newest patch clears the badge. New ruling [R2097000](spec/rulings/R2097000.md), with its §10.10 and §11 paragraphs and regenerated `spec/INDEX.md`.

- `apps/web/src/patches/diff.ts`: `flavor` added to `KNOWN_KEYS`, so `diffCard` never reports it.
- `apps/web/src/patches/deckChanges.ts` (new): `newestChanges` (changed + data-only cards of the newest patch, Glitch skipped by `patchCards`), `deckChanges` (held cards, empty once stamped with the newest version), `loadNewestChanges` (loads only while the newest patch is the catalog shown).
- `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/sync.ts`: `DeckItem.catalogVersion?` carried from the server stamp, set on create/edit/import, tolerated when absent in old mirrors; PUT body unchanged.
- `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckPatchBadge.tsx` (new): `useNewestChanges` hook and badge component rendering beside the row button / under the editor head.
- `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/testids.ts`, `workshop.css`, `zh-CN.json`, `apps/web/README.md`: ids, teal patch styles + touch sizing, three translations, README clause.
- Tests: `deckChanges.test.ts` (5), `DeckPatchBadge.test.tsx` (5), 3 new `sync.test.ts` cases.

## How I tested it

- `vitest run` green: deckChanges 5/5, DeckPatchBadge 5/5, sync 46/46, diff+history+deckChanges+sync 84/84, DeckWorkshop+DeckPatchBadge 51/51, routes/decks 22/22, decks-custom 5/5.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` clean, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` clean, `cargo fmt --check` clean, `cargo jackioh spec index` + `spec check` ok (1339 rulings), `catalog check` and `patches check` ok.
- One broad run showed 5 timeout failures (5s/30s); I proved them environmental by running the same test on a throwaway worktree at base `75a8fac2e` (also times out; load averaged 5–11 on this 2-CPU box, worktree removed after). The i18n tree-walk test's content was verified directly: the 3 new sentences exist in `zh-CN.json` with matching params.

- Data-only changes count (kept `...dataOnly`), since the issue excludes only flavor — noted as the plan's open question.
- No dismiss control; the server stamp already crosses devices.
- The badge clears at the edit (which autosave sends), not on server confirmation — recorded in R2097000.

## For the reviewer

- `DeckPatchBadge` renders nothing while loading or on load failure, and the `newest.version === catalog.version` guard keeps existing fixture-based workshop tests badge-free.
- The row badge is a sibling of the row `<button>`, never inside it; the editor badge sits beside `head` in `DeckSidebar`.
